explication: Easy Diffusion is a local Stable Diffusion image-generation application. Users configure models and generation parameters in the web UI, submit generation or image-filter tasks, and receive previews and saved images. The Python service exposes the API, queues work, selects devices, and delegates inference to a configurable backend. The README also documents prompt workflows, model management, image editing, themes, and plugins. Some UI-to-service wiring and unsampled feature implementations are not shown, so those relationships are omitted or marked unverified.
